name: Alert
desc: +5 to initiative; you can't be surprised.

name: Lucky
desc: 3 luck points per long rest: reroll a failed attack or save (automatic).

name: War Caster
desc: Advantage on CON saves to keep concentration; cast with hands full.

name: Great Weapon Master
desc: Toggle: -5 to hit, +10 damage with heavy melee weapons. Bonus attack after a crit or kill.

name: Sharpshooter
desc: Toggle: -5 to hit, +10 damage with ranged weapons. No disadvantage at long range.

name: Polearm Master
desc: Bonus action: 1d4 butt-end attack with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear.

name: Crossbow Expert
desc: Ignore loading; no disadvantage for ranged attacks in melee; bonus hand crossbow attack.

name: Tough
desc: +2 maximum HP per level.

name: Resilient (Strength)
desc: +1 STR and proficiency in STR saves.

name: Resilient (Dexterity)
desc: +1 DEX and proficiency in DEX saves.

name: Resilient (Constitution)
desc: +1 CON and proficiency in CON saves.

name: Resilient (Intelligence)
desc: +1 INT and proficiency in INT saves.

name: Resilient (Wisdom)
desc: +1 WIS and proficiency in WIS saves.

name: Resilient (Charisma)
desc: +1 CHA and proficiency in CHA saves.

name: Savage Attacker
desc: Once per turn, roll melee weapon damage twice and keep the higher.

name: Mobile
desc: +10 ft speed; creatures you attack in melee can't make opportunity attacks against you.

name: Elemental Adept
desc: Your spells ignore resistance to one damage type and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

name: Fey Touched
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Learn Misty Step and a 1st-level divination or enchantment spell.

name: Shadow Touched
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Learn Invisibility and a 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell.

name: Telekinetic
desc: +1 INT, WIS or CHA. Invisible Mage Hand; bonus action shove 5 ft (STR save).

name: Skill Expert
desc: +1 to any ability, one skill proficiency and one expertise.

name: Observant
desc: +1 INT or WIS; +5 passive Perception and Investigation.

name: Magic Initiate
desc: Learn two cantrips and a 1st-level spell from one class.

name: Artificer Initiate
desc: Learn an artificer cantrip and 1st-level spell.

name: Fighting Initiate
desc: Learn one fighting style.

name: Dual Wielder
desc: +1 AC while wielding two weapons; two-weapon fight with non-light weapons.

name: Heavy Armor Master
desc: +1 STR. In heavy armor, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage is reduced by 3.

name: Shield Master
desc: Add your shield's AC bonus to DEX saves; shove as a bonus action.

name: Mage Slayer
desc: Advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 ft.

name: Sentinel
desc: Your opportunity attacks stop movement; Disengage doesn't protect enemies from you.

name: Charger
desc: After dashing, attack as a bonus action for +5 damage.

name: Defensive Duelist
desc: Reaction: add proficiency to AC against a melee attack while wielding a finesse weapon.

name: Healer
desc: Use a healer's kit to stabilize and heal 1d6 + 4 + target's HD.

name: Inspiring Leader
desc: Allies gain level + CHA temporary HP when combat starts.

name: Martial Adept
desc: Learn two maneuvers and gain a d6 superiority die.

name: Spell Sniper
desc: Double the range of attack-roll spells; ignore half and three-quarters cover.

name: Eldritch Adept
desc: Learn one eldritch invocation.

name: Metamagic Adept
desc: Learn two metamagic options and gain 2 sorcery points.

name: Piercer
desc: +1 STR or DEX. Reroll one piercing damage die per turn; extra die on crits.

name: Slasher
desc: +1 STR or DEX. Slashing hits reduce the target's speed by 10 ft.

name: Crusher
desc: +1 STR or CON. Push targets 5 ft; crits grant advantage against them.

name: Durable
desc: +1 CON; hit dice heal more.

name: Athlete
desc: +1 STR or DEX; stand up with 5 ft of movement.

name: Ritual Caster
desc: Cast spells from a ritual book.

name: Poisoner
desc: Your attacks ignore poison resistance; brew potent poison.

name: Chef
desc: +1 CON or WIS; treats grant temporary HP.

name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
desc: Learn Cure Wounds; reaction wings add 1d4 + PB to AC against a hit.
